## Conclusion and Future Work {.nav-end}
We present [NaviGait]{.smallcaps}, a framework for applying RL to strategically transition between motion plans within a gait library.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="70%"}

1. Learns core locomotion skills faster than baseline approaches
2. Achieves similar robustness as Imitation RL.
3. Demonstrates superior imitation accuracy over Imitation RL.
:::

::: {.column width="30%"}
![](../media/Hero_Figure_presentation.svg){fig-align="center" style="max-width: 95%; margin-top: -1em;"}
:::

::::

However, [NaviGait]{.smallcaps} has its limitations, paving way for future work

1. Foot cross-over skills
2. Discouraged from extreme maneuvers
